decisionsTitle: An optional consent to offers and benefits from the club and its partners, per registration, behind the privacy notice
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-09-29 15:45:** «I need an extra check on the registration for participants to optionally receive promotional materials from us and from clients (this also has to be reflected in the GDPR notice)». The owner's «clients» are the club's partners and sponsors; the club's word is «parteneri». **The owner, 16:12 the same day, on the words:** the box reads «Vreau să primesc oferte și beneficii de la Brașov Runners și partenerii săi.» — «oferte și beneficii», the club by its name, «partenerii săi». **Amends §143** (a second optional consent under the list tick), **§445** (a second consent beside the newsletter, separate from it), **§550** (the newsletter page gains a second fold, for the same readers) and **the notice template of §322–§324**.

**The box.** One optional box on the registration form, per person, under «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți»: «Vreau să primesc oferte și beneficii de la Brașov Runners și partenerii săi.» / “I want to receive offers and benefits from Brașov Runners and its partners.” — the owner's sentence as the label, with its full stop, the club's name filled from `CLUB_NAME` (§215: the catalogue says `{club}`, never a second literal), the megaphone glyph, and one helper line «Opțional. Poți renunța oricând din pagina înscrierii tale.» / “Optional. You can opt out any time from your registration page.” — «Opțional» leads the helper rather than trailing the sentence's full stop. It is never pre-ticked, never required, never folded (§59) and never blocking: consent is a clear affirmative act (art. 4(11), 7 GDPR). It is on every event, whether or not the event publishes a list. Every word a person or the club reads says «oferte și beneficii» / “offers and benefits”: the helper, the switches, the backoffice line, the export's column, the newsletter's fold, the `/admin/tasks` row, the guide, the legend and the notice.

**Stored with its moment, and the moment kept.** `registrations.promo_consent` (boolean, NOT NULL, default false) and `registrations.promo_consent_at` (the moment of the tick, or of the last change through a switch), expand-only migration `0113_promo_consent`. The notice version a form's tick was given under is the row's existing `privacy_notice_version`; a later yes from the person's own page is given under the notice in force at `promo_consent_at` (the version windows on `/admin/legal` say which) — no third column. Because a withdrawal rewrites `promo_consent_at`, the moment a consent was first given lives on the audit trail: a form that keeps a tick writes one row `registration.promo_consent_changed` `{ to: true, via: FORM }` in the registration's own transaction (a restarted or corrected form that takes a yes back writes `{ to: false, via: FORM }`; an unticked box on a row that never said yes writes nothing), as the declaration page's tick writes `via: DECLARATION` — so after a withdrawal the club can still show that, and when, the person consented (art. 7(1) GDPR).

**The gate (AGENTS.md §10.8, the §396 mechanism).** A new merge field, `{{promotionalMaterials}}`, is both the words and the switch: filled with the box's own label, quoted, club name included, from the catalogue the form reads (`registrations/promo-consent-words.ts`), and read by `describesPromotionalMaterials`. The form offers the box only while the privacy notice in force names it in every language (`cachedPromotionalMaterialsOffered`); `submitRegistration` keeps a tick only when the notice this registration records names it — so a `true` is always consent to a text that described it, and a value posted while the notice does not describe it is ignored, never refused. `/admin/tasks` carries an open, never blocking row `promoNotice` with the steps; `/admin/legal` says the same beside the socials' line (`legal.promoMissing`); the legal editor's token legend lists the field, its example the same sentence with a plain «club», since the legend never names the club (§369). No text in effect changes: production keeps its approved notice until the club approves a new version from the template, and until then no box is shown and nothing is kept.

**Who may give it.** Only the person. A staff «Înscriere nouă» and the desk never set it — the service ignores a posted value on a staff origin, and the staff form says «Oferte și beneficii: nu» with the reason, while the notice describes it. On a family's sitting (§543) the address holder's own form keeps it, and a minor's form keeps it (the parent consents for the child, as for the list); another adult's does not (§421: `withoutAnotherAdultsConsents` and `withoutAnotherAdultsDetails` drop it). That adult gives it on their own declaration: the declaration page — each step of the family's wizard (§471) included — carries the same optional box, offered while the notice describes it and the registration has not said yes; a tick there is written in the signing transaction and ignored, never refused, when the notice does not describe it. A test registration is kept exactly like a real one (AGENTS.md §12.6) and listed nowhere.

**Per registration, and the words say so.** The consent is a column of the registration, not of the person: a person who ticked at one event and not at another has said yes to one and not to the other. So every door speaks of «această înscriere», never of the person at large: «La această înscriere primești oferte și beneficii.» / “On this registration you receive offers and benefits.”, «La această înscriere nu ai bifat oferte și beneficii.» / “You did not tick offers and benefits on this registration.”, and the switches «Nu mai vreau oferte și beneficii pentru această înscriere» / «Vreau oferte și beneficii pentru această înscriere». A switch changes that registration alone. The notice says the same: «răspunsul îl dai pentru fiecare înscriere în parte».

**Withdrawal (art. 7(3)).** `registrations/promo-consent.ts`, the shape of `list-consent.ts`: one write — the row locked, `promo_consent` and `promo_consent_at` set, one audit row `registration.promo_consent_changed` carrying `to: true|false` and the door, never a name — and four doors: the manage page, per person (§547), with the switch and the state in words, and «Înscrierile mele» (§77), with the state in words and the way out only (below), the token read and never spent on either; the declaration page, a yes only; and an Administrator on the registration's page, a withdrawal only, for a person who wrote to the club («Retrage consimțământul» gains «Acordul pentru oferte și beneficii»; the audit row names the actor and the reason). A yes is accepted only while the notice in force describes it; a no always — so the way out is shown whenever a registration says yes, even under a notice that no longer names the field, and «Înscrierile mele» lists a closed registration that still says yes — in words of its own, «Ai bifat oferte și beneficii la această înscriere. Cât timp e închisă, clubul nu îți trimite nimic pentru ea; poți retrage acordul oricând.» (`Registrations.promo.closedYes`), since the newsletter's fold never lists a closed registration. The same answer twice writes nothing. An Administrator's withdrawal of the health note, the socials or the results together with this consent is one transaction (`withdrawOptionalData`): whole or nothing.

**Another adult on the address: from the holder's link, only the way out.** The manage page lists the address's registrations at the event (§547). On another adult's row — not the link's own registration and not a minor today by the guardian rule's calendar (`anotherAdultOnTheLink`; a missing or unreadable birth date counts as an adult, the safe side) — it offers «Nu mai vreau oferte și beneficii pentru această înscriere» while the row says yes, and otherwise no button, only «Acordul pentru oferte și beneficii îl dă doar persoana, din declarația ei sau din linkul înscrierii ei. De aici îl poți doar retrage.». The server refuses a yes posted for such a row through another registration's link (FORBIDDEN), whatever the page drew. A minor's row keeps the yes: the parent consents for the child, as on the form. The adult says yes on their own declaration or through their own registration's manage link. This reverses the first round's reading that the per-person doors «trust the inbox»: the notice says another adult gives it themselves, and the holder's page now does what the notice says.

**«Înscrierile mele» is a door out only (second fix round).** That page lives under the address's own link (`MANAGE_PROFILE`), not one person's: it lists every registration of the address, another adult's included, and cannot tell the holder from that adult — and the notice names it only as a way to withdraw. So it offers «Nu mai vreau oferte și beneficii pentru această înscriere» while a row says yes, and on a row that says no — while the notice in force describes the offers — only one sentence, «Acordul pentru oferte și beneficii se dă din pagina înscrierii (linkul din emailul ei) sau din declarație. De aici îl poți doar retrage.» / “The consent to offers and benefits is given on the registration's own page (the link in its email) or on the declaration. From here you can only withdraw it.” (`Registrations.promo.whereToSayYes`). The server refuses a yes through this door for every row, the holder's own included, as FORBIDDEN (`setPromoConsentFromMyRegistrations`), whatever the page drew; a no is accepted as before. The yes is given on the form, on the declaration, or on the registration's own manage link — which says whose registration it is. This replaces the first fix round's «left as it was».

**Two consents, two switches.** The newsletter (§445) and this consent are separate: a newsletter unsubscribe does not touch `promo_consent`, and a withdrawal here does not touch the newsletter. The person's page says so in one sentence.

**The notice template** (both languages, section 5 «E-mailurile»; the twelve sections and their numbers, which the code and the guide cite, are kept): a paragraph «Oferte și beneficii:» naming `{{promotionalMaterials}}` — offers and benefits from the club and from its partners (sponsors, shops, the events' partners), sent by the club alone to the registration's address, the partners never receiving the address or any other data; answered for each registration separately; consent, art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and art. 12 of Law 506/2004 (in English «Romanian Law no. 506/2004», as the section's other paragraphs say it); the box optional and unticked; given when registering, when signing the declaration or later from the registration's page; for another adult on the address, only that person, when signing their declaration or from their own registration's link; withdrawn any time from the registration's page, «Înscrierile mele» or by writing to <EMAIL DE CONTACT> (the English text: <CONTACT EMAIL>, so the English notice is never filled with the Romanian «sau» between two addresses), with no consequence for the registration; separate from the newsletter; the list seen only by the club's organizers and administrators, who may download it. Section 6's «Nu le vindem…» adds «nici partenerilor clubului, ale căror oferte și beneficii ți le trimite clubul însuși». Section 7: «Acordul pentru oferte și beneficii: până îl retragi, dar nu mai mult decât înscrierea.» The four placeholders are untouched (§29). The template's own header says what changed; `/admin/legal` sees the moved template by its hash (§532).

**The backoffice and the exports.** The registration's page: «Oferte și beneficii: da, din <data> / nu» (shown while the notice describes it, or while the row says yes). The registrations CSV and spreadsheet end with «Offers and benefits» — the moment of the yes, or empty — last, so no column moves. `/admin/newsletter` gains a second fold under «Abonați», «Participanți care au bifat oferte și beneficii» (the `partners` glyph, closed by default, its line the count with `countForm`): name, address, event, the moment, newest first, at most 500 rows drawn and the whole list in its own «Descarcă CSV» (`GET /api/admin/newsletter/promo`, `oferte-si-beneficii-<date>.csv`, UTF-8 with a BOM, `csvCell`, the audit row `newsletter.promo_consenters_exported` with the row count only). Listed: a real registration whose address is proved and which still stands (waiting for its declaration, on the waiting list, offered, confirmed) — never an unproved address, a cancelled, expired or test one. The readers are §550's: the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator (`canSendNewsletter`), asserted in the page, the route and the read; a volunteer, the Redactor, Tehnic and a member get nothing. The guide says one sentence in the Organizer's and the Administrator's newsletter steps, and the GDPR request's withdrawal step names the new group.

**Refused.** A pre-ticked box, or one required to register (not a consent). A box shown before the notice describes it, or a tick kept under an older notice (§10.8). The address holder consenting for another adult (§421), on the form or from the holder's manage link. Staff ticking it for a person. Folding it into the newsletter (two purposes, two answers — art. 7(2)). A third email-link door with its own token purpose (an enum migration for a door the manage page already is). A separate column for the notice version of a later yes (the version windows answer it). Giving the partners the list (the club sends; the notice says so). Renaming the column `promo_consent` or the merge field `{{promotionalMaterials}}` to the new words: a migration and a changed marker in texts the club may already have approved, for no reader — only the words people read changed.
changelogLine: - **«Vreau să primesc oferte și beneficii de la Brașov Runners și partenerii săi.»** — one optional, unticked box per person on the registration form (and on the declaration page), shown only once the club approves a privacy notice from the new template; switched off or on again for each registration from its own page and off from «Înscrierile mele», another adult on the address saying yes only for themselves; «Oferte și beneficii: da/nu» on the registration's page, a column in the export, and a second fold on «Newsletter» with its own CSV for the Organizer and the Administrator. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the registration form while the privacy notice in force names `{{promotionalMaterials}}` in every language, when it renders, then it shows under the public-list tick one optional, unticked, not required box labelled «Vreau să primesc oferte și beneficii de la <club> și partenerii săi.», the club's name filled from `CLUB_NAME`, with a glyph and the line «Opțional. Poți renunța oricând din pagina înscrierii tale.»; while the notice does not name it, no such box is shown (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a public submission with the box ticked, when the registration is inspected, then `promo_consent` is true with `promo_consent_at` the submission's moment only if the privacy notice the registration records names `{{promotionalMaterials}}`; a tick posted under a notice that does not name it, from a staff or desk entry, or for another adult on a family's address is not kept, a minor's is, and a test registration is kept exactly like a real one (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a public submission whose tick is kept, when the audit trail is read after a later withdrawal has rewritten `promo_consent_at`, then it still holds the form's row `registration.promo_consent_changed` (`to: true`, `via: FORM`) at the submission's moment; an unticked box on a row that never said yes writes no row (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a declaration signed with the offers-and-benefits box ticked, including a step of the family's wizard, when the notice in force describes it, then the registration says yes with the signing moment and one audit row `registration.promo_consent_changed` (`to: true`, `via: DECLARATION`); when it does not, the tick is ignored and the signature goes on (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a registration that says yes to offers and benefits, when the person presses «Nu mai vreau oferte și beneficii pentru această înscriere» on the manage page or «Înscrierile mele», then `promo_consent` becomes false with the moment and one audit row carries `to: false` and the door; the same press twice writes nothing, the link is not spent, a stranger's registration id is refused as NOT_FOUND, and «Vreau oferte și beneficii pentru această înscriere» on the manage page is accepted only while the notice in force describes it (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given one address registered at two events, A ticked and B not, when B's page is read and B is switched on and off, then B's page reads «La această înscriere nu ai bifat oferte și beneficii.» before and «La această înscriere primești oferte și beneficii.» after, and A's `promo_consent`, `promo_consent_at` and audit rows are unchanged (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the address holder's manage link listing another adult and a minor registered on the same address, when the holder posts a yes for the adult, then it is refused as FORBIDDEN and nothing is written, the adult's row offers only «Nu mai vreau oferte și beneficii pentru această înscriere» while it says yes, a yes for the minor is kept, and the adult's own link may say yes (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Înscrierile mele» under an address's link, when it lists a registration that says yes, then it offers only «Nu mai vreau oferte și beneficii pentru această înscriere», and a registration that says no shows, while the notice in force describes the offers, no button but the sentence pointing to the registration's own page or the declaration; a yes posted through this link is refused as FORBIDDEN for every row, the holder's own and another adult's included, and nothing is written, a no is kept with one audit row `via: MY_REGISTRATIONS`, and the registration's own manage link still says yes (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a person subscribed to the newsletter who also said yes to offers and benefits, when the newsletter subscription is removed, then `promo_consent` is unchanged; and when offers and benefits are withdrawn, the newsletter subscription is unchanged (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the platform's privacy-notice template, when it is read in either language, then section 5 names `{{promotionalMaterials}}` under «Oferte și beneficii» / “Offers and benefits” and says the purpose, that only the club sends and the partners never receive the address, that the answer is given per registration, the basis art. 6(1)(a), that the box is optional and unticked and how it is withdrawn; section 6 names the partners as receiving nothing and section 7 the retention; no approved text changes, and `/admin/tasks` carries the open row `promoNotice` until a notice naming the field takes effect (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given registrations that said yes to offers and benefits, when «Newsletter» → «Participanți care au bifat oferte și beneficii» is opened or its «Descarcă CSV» downloaded, then it lists name, address, event and the moment of each real registration whose address is proved and which still stands — never a cancelled, expired, unproved or test one — and the registrations export ends with the column «Offers and benefits» (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the offers-and-benefits list and its CSV, when they are asked for, then the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator read and download them, and a volunteer, the Redactor, Tehnic and a member are refused on the server; an Administrator withdraws a person's consent from the registration's page with a reason, an Organizer is refused, and no staff door can say yes for a person (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: an optional consent to offers and benefits, per registration, behind the privacy notice
